offering_description.value: RingCentral sells cloud phone, messaging, video meeting and contact center software to businesses and public agencies. It also offers AI call answering, conversation analytics and virtual event tools. It hosts the software and delivers it through web, desktop and mobile apps and connected desk phones.

primary_products.value: cloud phone and collaboration software; contact center software; AI receptionist software; conversation analytics software; webinar and virtual event software

primary_services.value: implementation; phone system migration; systems integration; administrator and user training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize businesses, large enterprises, and private healthcare and education institutions; B2G: Public agencies and public school systems

end_markets.value: enterprise communications; customer service and contact centers; healthcare; education; public administration

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring plans for phone, collaboration, contact center and virtual event software; transaction or usage fees: Metered calling and usage above plan allowances; service fees: Implementation, migration and integration work
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines hosted software and carrier connectivity into communications tools for employers and public agencies; service provider: Configures and migrates phone and contact center systems for organizations adopting its software

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Cloud telephony, team collaboration, contact centers, AI call handling, conversation analytics and virtual events

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving business and public-sector accounts; partners / resellers: Telecom carriers, managed service providers and IT resellers; online: Self-service subscriptions through the company website; agents / brokers: Telecom agents and technology services distributors
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; online; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FCC interconnected VoIP rules for emergency calling and universal service, plus data privacy requirements
